marco-canepari.name: Marco Canepari
marco-canepari.role: Director, Rhythm Passport · selector and radio host
marco-canepari.bio: Founder and director of Rhythm Passport, the London world music magazine and gig guide. Presents the monthly Rhythm Passport Presents show: new releases from around the world plus a London gig calendar.

adaeze-nwosu.name: Adaeze Nwosu
adaeze-nwosu.bio: Digs West African highlife and Afrobeat pressings and plays them out on long Sunday sessions. Placeholder profile for the prototype.

lucia-ferreira.name: Lúcia Ferreira
lucia-ferreira.bio: Hosts a weekly Lusophone music show tracing the routes between Lisbon, Cape Verde, Angola and Brazil. Placeholder profile for the prototype.

kemal-aydin.name: Kemal Aydın
kemal-aydin.bio: Compiles Anatolian rock, Levantine disco and Caucasus electronics from 45s and cassettes. Placeholder profile for the prototype.

thandi-mokoena.name: Thandi Mokoena
thandi-mokoena.bio: Writes about and plays South African dance music, from kwaito and bubblegum to amapiano. Placeholder profile for the prototype.

rafa-medina.name: Rafa Medina
rafa-medina.bio: Runs a soundsystem night built on cumbia, champeta, son and salsa dura. Placeholder profile for the prototype.
